name: Norwalk Apparel Co.
old_description: Whether you're outfitting your staff, promoting your brand, or planning a school event, our team is here to help bring your vision to life. We offer top-quality embroidery and cutting-edge Direct-to-Film (DTF) printing services to give your gear a clean, professional look.
about:
Norwalk Apparel Co. operates from Norwalk, Connecticut, where it was founded by two passionate creatives with backgrounds in branding, apparel design, and small business growth. The pair launched the company to give local businesses and organizations the tools to represent themselves with confidence and style, staying hands-on with every order from design to final stitch.

The shop provides custom apparel decoration through three primary processes: Direct-to-Film (DTF) printing, embroidery, and vinyl decals. DTF transfers are produced on an Epson SureColor G6070, enabling vibrant, full-color prints on cotton, polyester, blends, and performance fabrics. Embroidery covers polos, hats, jackets, hoodies, uniforms, and bags, while vinyl decals serve vehicle lettering, storefront graphics, and equipment labeling. The company handles orders ranging from a single garment to large corporate runs and also supplies wholesale DTF transfers to other print shops.

Customers include businesses, schools, sports teams, fashion brands, event organizers, and fellow print shops. The company has outfitted employees with professional uniforms, produced spirit wear for schools, and created merchandise for fashion labels, in addition to providing wholesale transfers for screen-printing partners.

Norwalk Apparel Co. emphasizes fast turnaround times, competitive bulk pricing, and personalized customer service as its core differentiators. The founders frame the business as a partner rather than a vendor, aiming to help clients wear their identity proudly.
